flags.summary: Godrick showed Sir Godfrey Sir Aldric Ashgrove's sword (companions/ladle:sword).
Godrick and Sir Godfrey read the bottom of Godfrey's wall: Aldric rode for help (companions/ladle:wall).
Godrick asked Vladimir to knight him; Vladimir called Aldric a deserter (companions/ladle:vladimir).
The party started teaching Godrick to read (camp/godrick:letters).
Liriel asked the Abbot whether he still remembers the sun; opens her way to his repentance at the unveiling.
Liriel sang the dawn into Castle Ravenloft's chapel (companions/dawn:chapel_hymn).
Thistle found Fen's trail blaze on the crossroads signpost.
Thistle found Fen's left-handed blaze and the word RUN above Lake Zarovich.
Thistle found Fen Burley chained in the werewolf den.
What Thistle did for Fen: cured (Remove Curse), freed (into the high woods as a wolf) or rests (mercy).
Someone tried to tear Fen's rings out of the rock and failed; that way is spent.
Someone tried to pick Fen's silver cuffs and failed; that way is spent.
Kiril asked Thistle to run with his pack, and she answered him.
Ratatoille cooked supper for the Martikovs (companions/table:supper).
Ratatoille turned away from Zantras's offer of an audience forever.
Ratatoille passed judgement on Strahd's dinner, and heard his offer (companions/table:dinner).
Ratatoille refused Strahd's offer of a title and a tower at dinner.
Wren gave Kasimir Master Sorrel's letter.
Wren had Kasimir read Sorrel's 'let her rest' to Patrina's ghost.
Wren told Rahadin who his teacher was.
Master Vosk read Kip's contract and took his fee.
Kip kept Strahd's dinner invitation from the black carriage: a signature freely given.
Strahd signed for Kip at dinner, on the back of a bill for one apricot.
Strahd offered to buy Kip's contract at dinner (once).
Mister Quillon was paid with Strahd's signature and Kip's contract burned (camp/kip:settle).
